earliest_day.description:
EarliestDay is the first day for which any uptime data exists, in
YYYY-MM-DD UTC. Empty when no data yet.

latest_day.description: LatestDay is the most recent day we can report on (today UTC).

host_id.description: spec 079: optional link to a monitored host (null when unlinked)

category.description: Category is one of: resource | incident | page.

deep_link.description: DeepLink is the in-app path that opens the item (e.g. /resources/<id>).

id.description: ID is a stable, category-prefixed id: "resource:<id>" | "incident:<id>" | "page:<label>".

label.description: Label is the primary human-readable text (monitor name, incident cause, page name).

meta.description: Meta is short context (e.g. a monitor's target), omitted when empty.
